How well did you do on the test the first time?
options: Not so great. It was hard!

question_options.question: What do you think of Nate?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Maybe your heart was in the right place. I don't fault you for thinking of your future. But it's a matter of `fairness.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe your heart was in the right place. I don't fault you for thinking of your future. But it's a matter of [color=#3b78e2][i]fairness.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You seized it with more than two hands. You had an illegal `third` hand! That's too many hands!
nodes.text_bbcode: You seized it with more than two hands. You had an illegal [color=#3b78e2][i]third[/i][/color] hand! That's too many hands!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You're better than you know, Spencer. So I believe you deserve a second chance.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I've talked to the principal and to your football coach. They've agreed to let you stay on the team. No suspension. No blemish on your permanent record.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes. But that doesn't mean you're completely off the hook. You'll be joining a very special pet project of mine...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The team would suffer if I wasn't focused on practices. With this answer key, I wouldn't have to skip practices to study for this test.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Really? Do you honestly believe that the team would fall apart without you? Was trying to cheat really just a selfless act?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... I guess there was the added benefit of me having a future.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not some brainy guy. I know I won't have many opportunities after high school. I knew I had to seize this opportunity with two hands.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Guys like me don't have many options. I'm good for football, and not much else.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: After high school, there's not many places for me to go.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So when this opportunity came along, I knew I had to seize it with two hands.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I think Ms. Lee will have a few words to say about the matter.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ms. Lee?
That afternoon, Spencer sits in a chair in Ms. Lee's office as she paces back and forth, fanning herself with a file folder.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer, Spencer, Spencer... `Why?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer, Spencer, Spencer... [color=#3b78e2][i]Why?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just thought that--

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I can understand this sort of mayhem from those other `hoodlums` out in the hallways, but not from `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can understand this sort of mayhem from those other [color=#3b78e2][i]hoodlums[/i][/color] out in the hallways, but not from [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hoodlums?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But don't worry, I won't let them slander this perfect record of yours with these `lies!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't worry, I won't let them slander this perfect record of yours with these [color=#3b78e2][i]lies![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But, they're not lies. I `did` have the answer key in my backpack.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, they're not lies. I [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] have the answer key in my backpack.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer, how could you do this to me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: To... You?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I mean, to yourself! What could have possibly been going through your mind?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was thinking of...
Spencer freezes, wordless...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Well, your silence says it all. I had hoped you'd be mature enough to own up to your deeds, but maybe I overestimated you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: In any case, this still leaves the question of what must be done with you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No point in lying about it. I'll own up.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Well, I at least have to appreciate your maturity.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: But this still leaves the question of what must be done about you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not mine, I swear! Someone else gave it to me!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... I can't rat Nate out!
Spencer bites his lip, not saying a word.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Not saying, huh? Well, did this mysterious culprit `force you` to take the answer key against your will?
nodes.text_bbcode: Not saying, huh? Well, did this mysterious culprit [color=#e23b3b][i]force you[/i][/color] to take the answer key against your will?

nodes.text: Spencer's gaze sinks toward the floor.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I had hoped you would be mature enough to at least own up to your deeds. In any case this still leaves the question of what must be done with you.
With no other choice, Spencer empties his bag... And the answer key slides out onto his desk.
Mr. Dean snatches it up, his angry eyes lighting up with recognition.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: How do you explain this, Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's...
`BRRIIINNNG!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BRRIIINNNG![/b]

nodes.text: Mr. Dean is interrupted by the ringing of his phone. He answers, and Spencer watches as his facial expression turns grimmer and grimmer.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Hello? ...Oh?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: ...I see.
He hangs up the phone and turns a scowl toward his students.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I've just received some very disturbing news.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: It seems that a few days ago, an answer key went missing from the faculty lounge... And I'm told the culprit may be one of my own students.
A lump forms in Spencer's throat, a knot turning in his stomach...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: As I'm sure you all know, Twin Branches has a `very` strict no-cheating policy.
nodes.text_bbcode: As I'm sure you all know, Twin Branches has a [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] strict no-cheating policy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: As such, I'm conducting an impromptu search. I want all of you to empty your backpacks, `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: As such, I'm conducting an impromptu search. I want all of you to empty your backpacks, [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: All around him, Spencer's classmates pour the contents of their bags onto their desks.
Spencer stalls all he can, but eventually Mr. Dean looms over his shoulder and glares at him expectantly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: ...Well?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Oh really? And do you need to see the nurse?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope! I'm, uh, fine now.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: So you expect me to believe that you were afflicted with the world's shortest stomach flu?
Ripples of quiet laughter spread through the room.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Next time, Spencer, I'd appreciate it if you had the decency to--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is a really complicated lesson... I was just really wracking my brain trying to understand.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Oh... Well then, why didn't you ask for clarification?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't wanna interrupt you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I suppose that's considerate of you, but never be afraid to speak up! I can't help you if you don't--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Oh really? And do you need to see the nurse?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope! I'm, uh, fine now.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: So you expect me to believe that you were afflicted with the world's shortest stomach flu?
Ripples of quiet laughter spread through the room.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Next time, Spencer, I'd appreciate it if you had the decency to--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... I was...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: You were what? Spacing out, like you're doing at this very moment?
Ripples of quiet laughter spread through the room.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Next time, Spencer, I'd appreciate it if you had the decency to--

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Anyway, thanks man. You're doing the right thing. See you at practice!
Nate smiles and gives a wave as he walks off.
For the rest of the day, Spencer's conscience eats away at him, as the weight of the answer key in his backpack grows heavier and heavier...
He settles into Mr. Dean's class, but is unable to concentrate as the teacher begins his lecture.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What am I doing? Maybe I should just toss this stupid cheat sheet in the trash...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: I asked you a question! Are you even paying attention?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry! I, was...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The rules are there for a reason. I'm not one to take the easy way out.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey! You don't have to convince me. Everyone on the team knows you're a solid guy.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But a `lot` is at stake right now. Not just your future, but the team's.
nodes.text_bbcode: But a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] is at stake right now. Not just your future, but the team's.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Why don't you hold onto this, and just think about it some more?
Spencer sighs and stuffs the answer key into his backpack.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hmmf. Fine. I'll `think` about it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmmf. Fine. I'll [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] about it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess... It `would` allow me to concentrate on my training, which is good for the team... Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess... It [color=#e23b3b][i]would[/i][/color] allow me to concentrate on my training, which is good for the team... Right?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Right!
Spencer takes the answer key and slips it into his backpack as pang of guilt spreads through him.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did I just agree to?
Spencer rises from his seat and storms off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer! Wait!
Spencer exits into the hallway, fuming. Just then, a familiar voice calls to him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey! Missed you at practice!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, Nate. Yeah, I've been pretty busy studying for the entrance exam for the--

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Steelman Football Camp, I remember. Listen, when I said I was glad to have you on our side, I meant it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But we've got our first game of the season coming up, and if you're gonna play your best for the team, you need to keep your head in the `game`, not distracted by some test!
nodes.text_bbcode: But we've got our first game of the season coming up, and if you're gonna play your best for the team, you need to keep your head in the [color=#e23b3b][i]game[/i][/color], not distracted by some test!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... I mean, I wanna play my best too, but this exam...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Is `unreasonably` hard. Everyone says so. Unless, you happen to have a leg up...
nodes.text_bbcode: Is [color=#e23b3b][i]unreasonably[/i][/color] hard. Everyone says so. Unless, you happen to have a leg up...

nodes.text: Nate shifts his gaze around, checking to see if anyone is watching... Then discreetly hands Spencer a small booklet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's this?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's the `answer key` for the Steelman Program entrance exam!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's the [color=#e23b3b][i]answer key[/i][/color] for the Steelman Program entrance exam!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Hey... I don't know how I feel about cheating...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I get it. It's not 100% legit...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But it would let you focus on football, support the team, `and` help your chances at getting into the program! It's the best of all worlds!
nodes.text_bbcode: But it would let you focus on football, support the team, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] help your chances at getting into the program! It's the best of all worlds!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: At the end of the day, you've gotta ask yourself what kind of person you are. Are you someone who blindly follows the rules, or someone who does what needs to be done, for the good of everyone?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm someone who...

options.label: Does what needs to be done.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah, I got this... It's...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Henry the Eighth!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That... Has nothing to do with American history.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Henry the Ninth?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can't be afraid to `ask for help` sometimes, man. It's crucial.
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't be afraid to [color=#e23b3b][i]ask for help[/i][/color] sometimes, man. It's crucial.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh! Whatever. I'm too dumb to get this stuff anyway.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, actually. Can we go through this chapter again? I've forgotten the key points.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You've forgotten the Alamo? I specifically asked you to remember!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't make me beat the knowledge out of you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Joking! And I'm glad you spoke up! Some people are too stubborn to ask for help when they need it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No lie, I kinda hate it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I really wanna get this stuff down. And sometimes you need backup from a teammate.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right then. Let's get to it.
Ben patiently goes over the history lesson again. The two hunker down and concentrate, but before long, Spencer's frustration grows...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh! It's pointless! I'm too dumb to get this stuff anyway.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... It's...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Help you study what? You and I don't even have the same summer school classes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I dunno! I just need to find a way to prove myself. Prove that I can do... You know, not just football stuff, but smart stuff too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You could try wearing glasses on the field. Might make you look brainier.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You could try wearing a `black eye.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You could try wearing a [color=#e23b3b][i]black eye.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was a joke! Look... There are other ways you can prove you're well-rounded.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you can apply for the Huff Puffington Scholarship, the YouthForce Learn-a-Thon, the Steelman Football Camp, the Shiny Scholars Club, the--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait! The football one! I choose that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, how does that prove I'm a good student?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, it's a really prestigious football camp. Almost every student selected for it goes on to receive a football scholarship from a really good college.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But, the people selected for it have to show both academic and athletic excellence.
From a few feet away, Nate pricks up his ears and turns to the two of them.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Whoa, you're going for the Steelman Program?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Pretty bold, man. The entrance exam for the program is one of the hardest tests ever!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I, uh... I don't do so well with tests.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you're gonna need someone to help you study. Someone smarter than me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think I know just the person..
A few days later, Spencer gathers at a cafeteria table with his friend Ben and a stack of textbooks.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Rrrr! I'll never get this! Can't believe I'm missing practice to study American History. We've been on this chapter forever!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've only met a couple times so far. Now, come on! You can do this! Just take your time, and think about the question...
Spencer stares down at the text in his book... And sees nothing but a jumble of vocabulary and dates swirling in his mind into an incomprehensible mess...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Need to go over it again?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just wanna make sure I'm performing my best on the field.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think that's what the coach was worried about. You're doing great out there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think it's academics he was telling you to focus on.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh... I was afraid of that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, `you've` been juggling the whole sports-and-classes thing. Think you could help me with studying?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]you've[/i][/color] been juggling the whole sports-and-classes thing. Think you could help me with studying?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My skills on the field are the strongest they've ever been...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...But in class, I'm totally `weak.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But in class, I'm totally [color=#e23b3b][i]weak.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Think you could help me study?
`CRASH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]CRASH![/b]

nodes.text: Spencer collides with him, knocking the wind from his lungs... And the ball from his hands!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As the two hit the ground, Nate fumbles the ball onto the grass! Without skipping a beat, Spencer climbs to his feet and scoops it up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Got it!
Spencer makes a dash for the endzone! The other team chases after him desperately, but Spencer deftly evades them, sprinting yard after yard down the field...
...And running the ball into the endzone for a game-winning touchdown! The coach blows his whistle sharply, signifying the end of practice.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes!
Spencer's scrimmage teammates run over to him, whooping and cheering!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Awesome sack, Spence!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All right, all right. Let's not get cocky. The first game of the season is coming up soon! ...And Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Good hustle out there. You're a natural. You might be one of the best talents Twin Branches has seen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I mean it. You've got a `future` ahead of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean it. You've got a [color=#e23b3b][i]future[/i][/color] ahead of you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A future?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Sure. As long as you prove yourself off the field, too!
The coach waves as he dismisses the team to the locker rooms and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure... Off the field...
Later, Spencer slumps down onto a bench in the locker room as the other players change out of their gear. Nate wanders over, giving Spencer a curt nod.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Lucky shot out there, man. You almost knocked me out of my gear. Remind me to return the favor.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right. My bad...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Relax, I'm messing with you. I'm just glad you're on our side. I'd hate to be competing against you for real.
Nate turns for his locker as Owen approaches and gives Spencer a slap on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good job out there, man! Coach seemed really impressed!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh. Right. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Something up? You look like someone spit in your cereal.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Spit it out, man.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right... It's something the coach said. He said there's a future for me if I stay ahead 'off the field'. What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He's probably just saying you gotta balance athletics and academics to get into a good college or land a scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Makes sense. We've all gotta think about life after high school at some point. What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just... Feel like I should be doing `more...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just... Feel like I should be doing [color=#e23b3b][i]more...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, are you free to help me out later? I think I need to work on my...
Score Up!
Spencer whirls his body, breaking away from his opponent and circling around him in a flash!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha!
He darts toward Nate, diving at him just as he cocks his arm back for a pass!
Spencer pushes with all his might, but the defender hold his ground! He starts to force Spencer back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Gah!
Meanwhile, Nate cocks his arm, preparing to throw the ball!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Running out of time! Gotta get to him before he throws!
Spencer darts to his left, ripping away from the lineman's grip!
He dives at Nate just moments before he makes a pass!
Spencer freezes, unsure what to do!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's, uh... Kind of a long story. It has to do with how I ended up with the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooh! A Spencer origin story! I was wondering when we'd get to hear this one!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It might help to vent these feelings aloud.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, and it's not like we're going anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We can listen while we work!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I guess it's about time you guys heard it anyway.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It started back towards the end of summer...
You are now playing as Spencer!
Weeks ago...
The football team takes position on the field for a practice scrimmage as their coach looks on from the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: It's down to the wire! Make this play count, boys!
Spencer hunches down at the line of scrimmage.
Clearing his mind, he focuses on his target... `Nate,` the quarterback.
nodes.text_bbcode: Clearing his mind, he focuses on his target... [b]Nate,[/b] the quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Down... Set...
Across from him, the offensive line braces themselves for impact...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No matter what... Once the play starts, I'm breaking through this line and tackling Nate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: `...Hike!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...Hike![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The center snaps the ball into Nate's hands! Spencer charges forward, crashing into the lineman in front of him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Hrrah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Pads clash loudly as Spencer grapples with the lineman!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No good! I can't overpower this guy! I've got to get around him to make the sack!
With a second burst of energy, Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How would you know? None of you know what I've been through.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I didn't mean to offend. I only meant that, whatever it is, we'll help you get through it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... Hey, sorry, I didn't mean to lose my cool.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's just that there's more to this day than just lame book-shelving.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We're a team now. We'll get through this library task together!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. It's cool that you guys got my back and all, but...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: There's more to it than that.

nodes.speaker: Allison

Spencer sprints up and down the bleachers at Twin Branches High, pushing himself to the brink of exhaustion, his lungs aching with every gasp...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hey! Spencer!
Spencer slows and turns to see $ALLISON with the rest of the Troublemakers.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We missed you at community service. Where were you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where else? Out here, training.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing out so late again, man? You're pushing yourself way too hard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've nurtured your muscles, but what of your `soul,` Spencer?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've nurtured your muscles, but what of your [color=#e23b3b][i]soul,[/i][/color] Spencer?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, you're being pretty stubborn. And that means something coming from me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, none of you understand. How could you? Football is all I have, now. You'll all go on to do awesome things...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `...But this is all I'll ever be!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...But this is all I'll ever be![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A hush falls over the group.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Spencer... Failing that entrance exam wasn't the end of the world. As your friend, I'm begging you to--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Please... Just go. I'd like to be alone.
$ALLISON nods sadly and leads the others as they turn away.
And as Spencer continues his endless sprints, he grits his teeth and swallows his sadness, knowing in his heart...
...He has failed.

nodes.text: Today...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...And that's how I ended up here.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: OMG, Spencer... I had no idea...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Can't you try again for the entrance exam?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, there `is` another chance. They host a Fall entrance exam for late applicants.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] another chance. They host a Fall entrance exam for late applicants.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then you should go for it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The problem is that the exam is `tomorrow morning...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The problem is that the exam is [color=#e23b3b][i]tomorrow morning...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Even `if` I wanted to try, I would have to study like crazy, and I can't because I'm stuck here all day!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Even [color=#e23b3b][i]if[/i][/color] I wanted to try, I would have to study like crazy, and I can't because I'm stuck here all day!

nodes.text: Spencer tosses a book onto the ground angrily. A quiet settles over the group, until...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...So what?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh?
$ALLISON picks up one of the fallen books.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So what if you're stuck here? You can study as you shelve.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the point? There's no way someone like me can pass this test without a cheat sheet. I'm just a dumb jock!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's bull and you know it. You never `needed` that answer key.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's bull and you know it. You never [color=#e23b3b][i]needed[/i][/color] that answer key.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You've got books, determination, and five people willing to help you study!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's like an all-you-can-eat buffet, but your `brain` is your stomach, and knowledge is your food, and the five of us are your food-butlers!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like an all-you-can-eat buffet, but your [color=#e23b3b][i]brain[/i][/color] is your stomach, and knowledge is your food, and the five of us are your food-butlers!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not how `any` of that works.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not how [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] of that works.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But... It would just be a waste of time! The exam covers all types of subjects! There's no way I can cram it all!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's weird. I didn't figure you for a `quitter,` Spencer.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's weird. I didn't figure you for a [color=#3b78e2][i]quitter,[/i][/color] Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? I'm not a quitter!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Good. Because we're not giving up on you either. You `totally` got this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. Because we're not giving up on you either. You [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] got this!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We got your back, man. You're gonna crush this test!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What kind of food-butlers would we be if we abandoned our posts?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So what do you say, Spencer? Will you let us help you?
$ALLISON hands Spencer a textbook. He contemplates it for a moment, and then smirks.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...All right. Let's do this!
Soon, the Troublemakers mobilize, shelving books as they take turns coaching Spencer.

Days later, Nate waits in the empty locker room of an unfamiliar school a few towns over from Centerscore. He taps his foot impatiently.
Where the heck is he? When he finally shows up, I'm gonna give him a piece of my--
Wes saunters out from the shadows with a casualness that only infuriates Nate more.
Some things can't be rushed. Had to make sure the coast was clear.
Our football team is at an away game. We've got time.
Wonderful. This is all very cloak-and-dagger, but can we get to business?
Of course! What is it you'd like to discuss?
Payback. Spencer made a fool of me during football practice, and now he's trying to take my spot at the Steelman Football Camp. You're gonna help make him `regret it.`
And why would I do that?
You do what `I` tell you to do because `I'm` the one telling you to do it!
That's how this works, isn't it? I pay you, and you get me the secrets and schemes I need to socially `destroy` Spencer!
I mean unfortunately, my business model has changed since we last met. I don't do petty revenge anymore, Nate.
What?! You were the `king` of shady business when you were still at Twin Branches.
The story is that scheming got you expelled from our high school.
Yeah, well, I'm making a new high school story.
If you wanted some info, some juicy gossip... I'd be open for business. But if you're asking me to help take down Spencer just cuz you've got a `grudge?`
No dice, Nathan. I'm no evil henchman-for-hire.
Fine. I'm getting my revenge on Spencer one way another, even `without` your help.
He turns to leave, shaking his head.
I don't know what or `who` happened to you, Wes, but you've gone soft. You've forgotten who you are.
Just the opposite, Chief. Things are different at this school. I can be myself. I know `exactly` who I am.
Nate flings the door open angrily. Wes flashes him a smile... One that instantly disappears the moment the door swings closed.
The Troublemakers stop abruptly in the midst of their newest community service task. A stunned silence hangs in the room...
I think we `all` heard you, and can agree it was spoken in the heat of the moment, so there's no need to--
Say it again. I `dare` you to say it again.
Oh, I'd be delighted to repeat it.
Erik puts his palms over his ears!
'Paige, you're a spoiled, materialistic princess putting on an act to hide how shallow you are!'
Paige crushes the ceramic cup in her fist and lunges at Owen, shouting curses!
Kimi and $ALLISON swoop in and hold Paige back as she kicks and screams!
Meanwhile, Spencer grabs the irate Owen!
We're stepping outside. You need to cool down, man!
Owen fumes, grumbling and cursing as Spencer pulls him out of the room!
`Ugh!` Can you believe him? He's way outta line. He couldn't be more wrong!
Kimi shoots $ALLISON a glare and a harsh whisper.
What are you doing? We're in calm-Paige-down mode!
Paige shakes free of their grip and composes herself, smoothing her clothes.
If Little Red here wants to know the deal with me and Owen, I'll talk. It's what we do in this club, isn't it?
Might as well settle in, then. It's `story time...`
